dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: My friend, could I borrow you for just a moment to ask you a question?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm busy at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Hey, it's not that kind of question!

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Just purely out of curiosity, are you a fan of carrots?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm, I've got other matters to attend to at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Oh, no worries. See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're alright. Very nutritious.

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Aha, I knew it! There are still people out there who appreciate the miracle that is the humble carrot.

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Whenever anyone asks me how I keep my eyes so sharp, I always tell them to eat carrots.

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: But most of them just shake their heads and say something like, even if the only alternative was drinking the Masters of the Night-Wind's potions, they'd still choose the latter.

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: I don't think they taste that bad though...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: My friend, I'm very touched to hear you say that. I sometimes wonder if there's a god of carrots out there somewhere... If there is, he'll surely be looking out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I find them questionable. They taste like soil...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: O—Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Sorry, I look a bit disappointed, don't I? Don't mind me, it's not your fault.

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: As a competition referee, I respect everyone's right to love or hate carrots as they so choose.

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: I just didn't expect that there were so many people out there who hated them so vehemently. Almost eight or nine out of ten, if you'd believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: I can't say for sure that my good eyesight is all down to my love for carrots, but surely a vegetable that's such a lovely color must be doing something right... right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't judge a book by its cover...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Ah, now that you mention it... There's definitely some people who look cute enough, but are real difficult to get along with...

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: Err, I'm not talking about anyone specifically, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Camac
dialogues.text: *cough* Anyway, back to food... What do people who aren't fond of carrots generally eat? Meat?
